description.en: The handle of this harvesting knife is made of wood, with a handlebar-shaped iron blade inserted at the middle of the handle to cut rice stalks. The ends of the iron blade have different designs: one is jagged at the tip, and the other is grooved and pointed.
description.fil: Ang hawakan ng kutsilyong pang-aning ito ay yari sa kahoy, na may talim na bakal na hugis-manibela na isinuksok sa gitna ng hawakan upang putulin ang tangkay ng palay. Magkaiba ang disenyo ng mga dulo ng talim na bakal: ngipin-ngipin ang isang dulo, at may ukit at tulis ang isa pa.
description.de: Der Griff dieses Erntemessers besteht aus Holz; in seiner Mitte sitzt eine lenkerförmige Eisenklinge zum Schneiden der Reishalme. Die Enden der Eisenklinge sind unterschiedlich gestaltet: das eine ist an der Spitze gezackt, das andere gekehlt und zugespitzt.

condition.en: Fair and stable condition, with abrasions on the handle and inactive corrosion on the blade.
condition.fil: Katamtaman at matatag ang kalagayan, may gasgas sa hawakan at hindi aktibong kalawang sa talim.
condition.de: Mäßiger, stabiler Zustand, mit Abschürfungen am Griff und inaktiver Korrosion an der Klinge.

images.alt: Harvesting knife (pang-ani) with a mustache-shaped iron blade set through a wooden dowel handle, its two jagged and grooved tips curving outward
The pang-ani's wooden handle end, inked with its accession number, angled to show the iron blade's curve and pointed tip
